StudySieve can be used to help students learn by encouraging them to generate and answer free response questions.
the use of StudySieve in a large undergraduate course is a valuable educational tool, but the exact circumstances under which it is most effective require further investigation.

student generated questions can provide a valuable resource for instructors to use in their courses, and that students are willing to contribute questions and answers for the benefit of their peers.
